source_refs.note: Ortho-Para Directing Groups (Activating Groups): a main subheading of 20.4 Orientation in Electrophilic Substitution Reactions, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 68-68.

blocks.text: Jo group ring ko benzene se zyada reactive banaye aur aane wale electrophile ko sirf ortho aur para positions par lagaye, use ortho-para director kehte hain. Aise substituents “ortho” (1,2) ya “para” (1,4) product dete hain, aur para thora zyada banta hai. Is mein ortho aur para products zyada bante hain aur meta product bohat hi kam. Ortho-para directors ki misalein: -SR, -R, -OH, -OR, -NR₂, -SH. Yeh sab woh groups hain jo benzene ring ko electrons de sakte hain.

Methyl benzene ke ring ki chlorination aluminium chloride (bromine ke liye aluminium bromide) ya iron ki presence (mojoodgi) mein aur UV roshni ke baghair hoti hai. Yeh reactions room temperature par hoti hain. Methyl group 2,4-directing (o-p directing) hai, yani naya group zyada tar ring ki position 2 ya 4 par jata hai. Chlorine se 2-chloromethylbenzene aur 4-chloromethylbenzene ka mixture banta hai.

blocks.alt: 2 methylbenzene + 2Cl2, arrow ke oopar AlCl3 aur neeche anhydrous (pani ke baghair), se 2-chloromethylbenzene + 4-chloromethylbenzene + 2HCl. CH3 group highlighted hai, is note ke saath: electron dene wala (electron-donating) alkyl group jo 2 aur 4 positions ko activate (zyada reactive) karta hai.
blocks.caption: Methylbenzene ki chlorination (kitab ke PDF page 69 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki equation mein ek methylbenzene + 2Cl₂ se dono products + 2HCl likhe hain, jo balanced nahi: ek molecule se ek hi product banta hai. Sahi: 2 methylbenzene + 2Cl₂ → 2-chloromethylbenzene + 4-chloromethylbenzene + 2HCl (ya har molecule ke liye: C₆H₅CH₃ + Cl₂ → ClC₆H₄CH₃ + HCl).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: CH₃ ring ko electrons deta hai, is liye ring zyada reactive ho jati hai aur Cl zyada tar position 2 (ortho) aur 4 (para) par lagta hai.
Bromine se isi tarah ke bromine compounds bante hain. Methyl group ki tarah OH group bhi ring ko active karta hai, is liye naye groups zyada tar positions 2, 4 aur 6 par jate hain.
